title: A run's trace id in kbmon --events depends on when the export ran: the items of a closed sprint export with their own trace and no parent
goal: kbmon --events gives the kb.item span of an item of a sprint the same trace before and after the sprint is closed and its item files are deleted

gates.question: How does kbmon --events read the sprint of an item whose file a sprint close deleted: from git history or from a sprint field of the claim move? Git history needs no change outside mon_events.py and covers runs already in the coord store; the claim field would change bl_items and bl_land, outside the touches.

notes: Found by the review of SP-hja7yu5k (mon_events.py:123-130): the sprint of an item is read from the backlog files, which close deletes. An adapter restarted after close exports the items under another trace and drops the root. The fix reads the sprint from the item's claim move (a `sprint` field of the claimed progress event) or from the closed sprint's commit. Planned into SP-ymnz7b4n, 2026-10-24 day run. Precheck: repro fails on the base.
